author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/12/2018: FB, INTC, PLAB
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT, +1.1%
AAPL, +0.6%
IBM, +0.7%
CSCO, +1.3%
GOOG, +1.8%
Technology stocks were in positive territory ahead of the session's close this Wednesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 up about 0.7%.
In company news, Facebook ( FB ) and ZeniMax have reached a settlement over a lawsuit that claimed Facebook stole ZeniMax technology fPLAor the Oculus virtual reality headset, according to media reports. Terms of the settlement were not disclosed. In the lawsuit, ZeniMax claimed Oculus founder Palmer Luckey took computer code and proprietary information from Zenimax to develop the Oculus VR headset. It also alleged that Oculus' chief technology officer John Carmack used his experience and knowledge as a former ZeniMax employee to improve the device. FB shares rose some 2.5%.
In other sector news,
(+) Intel ( INTC ) Held its Architecture Day where it launched next-generation technologies and discussed progress on the technical strategy it is pursuing in six engineering segments
(-) Photronics ( PLAB ) Reported financial results for fiscal Q4, with better-than-expected revenue and earnings that matched analysts' forecasts; it also provided guidance for fiscal Q1 just short of Street estimates.
